tests: a name pasted into Project Name keeps its space and its dot, and becomes the project's name, title and root folder; it builds with no diagnostic
steps:
1. File > New Project..., double-click Standard EXE.
2. In Project Name, type My Project.x_1: the box reads MyProjectx_1.
3. Select the text and paste My Project.x: the box reads My Project.x.
4. Continue: the project's name, title and root folder are My Project.x, and it builds Build\My Project.x_win32.exe with no diagnostic.
Control: typed text is filtered.
